steps.text: 5 starting area tiles shuffled faceup on the middle spaces; the other 25 area tiles shuffled facedown on the rest
4 of the 5 large location tiles, random side up, on the corner spaces; box the fifth
Machine tokens in 3 piles by color; 3 from each faceup
Crate tokens shuffled in a facedown stack
Leave the campaign deck unshuffled and unseen; falcon and red punch boards stay in the box
Player board and a random tribe board, sun side up, to its left
Grey, green and yellow machine track markers on space 1; 1 energy in your storage; switch token slid up
A set of 6 starting citizen cards with the same letter: shuffle, 3 facedown to the right (resting area), 3 faceup below your tribe board
5 small and 3 large buildings and 7 population figures on your tribe board
Pawns: one on 0 of the point track, one on the lowest hibernation space
20 progress markers: 15 on the machine track reward spaces, 5 along the bottom of your tribe board
4 resource markers on the bottom of the resource tracks
Starting resources in turn order: 1st crystal; 2nd crystal + gear; 3rd crystal + gear + book; 4th one of all four
Solo: start with 1 crystal; 1 action cube on the first space of the progress track
Pick a starting player at random
